prompt:
A horizontal strip of pixel art showing the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised wall/ledge, exactly as such faces look in a top-down JRPG map (we look straight at the face; it is the drop between an upper level and the floor). It fills the whole image edge to edge: the top 6% is the lit rim/lip of the upper surface, the face below gets gradually darker toward the bottom, and the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where it meets the floor. No floor, no sky, no objects in front. SEAMLESS horizontally (left edge continues into the right edge). The strip is about 256 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels). Material: a pale grey-blue stone city wall with carved star motifs in a band and a cornice on top
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
revised_prompt: Generate a single horizontal, edge-to-edge tileable pixel-art texture of the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised stone city wall/ledge as viewed straight-on in a top-down JRPG map. Wide 2:1 aspect ratio, designed as approximately 256 x 128 logical art pixels, with every logical art pixel an equally sized sharply bounded square, approximately 7–8 display pixels square. The TOP 6% is a narrow lit stone rim/lip and layered carved cornice, not a visible ground plane. Beneath is ONLY the vertical face, pale grey-blue coursed masonry with a continuous architectural band of carved star motifs; cohesive worn but refined city-wall blocks with clearly readable relief and repeating stonework. Gradually deepen the wall-face palette toward the bottom; bottom 8% a continuous darker contact band at the meeting with an unseen floor. Absolutely no visible floor, upper walking surface, sky, scenery, props, or foreground. Make the left and right boundaries connect exactly as a seamless horizontally repeating tile: matching masonry courses, motif band, cornice, colors, and marks. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art JRPG environment tile, hand-placed pixels, blocky discrete clusters of 3–10 pixels, crisp grid aligned geometry, no anti-aliasing, blur, soft brushes, photo texture, noise, or checkerboard dithering. 4–6 well-chosen shades per material, restrained warm yellow highlights and slightly saturated muted purple-red shadow hues within pale grey-blue stone; rich earthy worn appearance. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast evening illumination. Base color texture only: no cast shadows, artificial lights, glow, night darkness, vignette or lamp pools. Exact flat frontal orthographic elevation, continuous full bleed horizontal strip.
